title: Coordination on a Budget: Federated Active Learning with Few Labels
summary: This paper examines Federated Active Learning (FAL) in a low-budget regime, addressing challenges of data privacy and label scarcity for coordinated query selection across data silos.

title: ProxyGuard: Direct Reliability Inference for Randomized Data Release Mechanisms with Shared Targets
summary: This paper introduces ProxyGuard, a method for direct reliability inference of randomized data release mechanisms with shared targets, ensuring data adequacy while controlling error risks.

title: FlashAttention for Scalable Vector Architectures
summary: This paper discusses optimizing Transformer model inference on CPUs using scalable vector architectures, highlighting FlashAttention as a key method to mitigate memory bandwidth bottlenecks.

title: Computational Measurement of Team-Process Phase Dynamics in Collaborative Virtual Reality
summary: This research explores computational methods to measure team-process phase dynamics in collaborative virtual reality environments, offering a new way to analyze communication and coordination over time.

title: Reinforced Planning with Latent World Models
summary: This work explores 'Reinforced Planning with Latent World Models,' an approach where AI constructs plans and mentally simulates outcomes using an internal world model, improving upon traditional planning methods.

title: An Empirical Benchmark of Deep Time-Series Models for Smart Meter Energy Forecasting
summary: This study presents an empirical benchmark comparing various deep time-series models for smart meter energy forecasting, aiming to improve power system operations and energy management.

title: Transforming Heart Disease Prediction with Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
summary: This research investigates the use of advanced machine learning techniques for heart disease prediction, comparing the performance of multiple classifiers to improve early and accurate detection.

title: Europe's Climate Ambition Under Scrutiny: Evidence from Deep Learning Emission Projections
summary: This paper applies deep learning to high-resolution socioeconomic data to project greenhouse gas emissions in EU27 member states and assess alignment with climate goals.

title: Visual-Aware Representation of Web Pages for Machine Learning Applications
summary: This research explores methods to create visual and layout-aware representations of web pages, enabling machine learning applications to better interpret HTML and associated resources.

title: FedLNS: Leverage LayerNorm Signature Modeling to Mitigate Adversarial Manipulation in Federated LLMs
summary: This paper introduces FedLNS, a method using LayerNorm Signature Modeling to detect and mitigate adversarial manipulation by malicious clients in federated large language model training.

title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
summary: This research investigates decision-metric alignment in latent world models, proposing diagnostics and action-conditioned objectives to improve Model-Predictive Control (MPC) planning by ensuring task progress.

title: Geometric Data Perturbation with Noisy-Anchor Alignment for Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Learning
summary: This paper proposes Geometric Data Perturbation with Noisy-Anchor Alignment as a privacy-preserving method for collaborative learning, enabling secure data sharing under analyst-participant collusion.

title: To Go Far, Go Together: Diverse Preferences Induce a Curriculum for Reward Optimization
summary: This research explores how diverse human preferences can create a curriculum for reward optimization, improving the alignment of AI systems with individual users through human feedback.

title: GraphK: Variable-Size Graph Generation with Efficient Edge Construction
summary: This paper introduces GraphK, a novel encoder-sampler-decoder framework for variable-size graph generation that addresses scalability and flexibility limitations in existing deep learning models.

title: A Real-Time Tsetlin Machine-based Non-intrusive Load Monitoring System on MCUs
summary: This research presents a real-time Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) system implemented on microcontrollers, utilizing a Tsetlin Machine to estimate individual appliance energy consumption.

title: Forgetting, plasticity, and co-observation: a third facet of continual learning
summary: This paper investigates the fundamental challenges in continual learning for deep neural networks, identifying "co-observation" as a third critical facet alongside catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity.

title: Many Optimizers But Only One Training Path: Repeated Resampling for Adaptive Optimizer Selection
summary: This paper introduces Repeated Optimizer Resampling (ROR), a method for adaptively selecting optimizers during deep neural network training to improve performance without multiple full training runs.

title: LongNovel: A Multi-Scale Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Long-Context Novel Summarization
summary: This paper introduces LongNovel, a multi-scale benchmark designed to evaluate and detect hallucinations in large language models specifically when performing long-context novel summarization.

title: Entity tracking emerges in sub-billion parameter language models and exceeds human performance in naturalistic narratives
summary: This research finds that sub-billion parameter language models exhibit entity tracking capabilities, even surpassing human performance in understanding naturalistic narratives.

title: Compiler-Guided Adaptive Proof Search with Cross-Model Synergy on Context-Dependent Theorem Proving
summary: This paper proposes a compiler-guided adaptive proof search method with cross-model synergy to improve context-dependent theorem proving, especially in real-world Lean 4 projects.

title: Persona-Guided LLM Agents for Task-Oriented Dialogue
summary: This research explores persona-guided large language model (LLM) agents for task-oriented dialogue, examining how diverse personality traits can be expressed without compromising task completion.

title: SuTRA : Structurally-Unified Tokenization with Root Awareness
summary: This paper introduces SuTRA, a novel tokenization method that improves upon existing subword tokenizers by incorporating morphological structure and root awareness, particularly for Indic languages.

title: Latent Space Refusal Anchoring for Low-Resource African Languages: Mechanistic Safety Recovery Without Retraining
summary: This research proposes latent space refusal anchoring to recover mechanistic safety in instruction-tuned models for low-resource African languages, enabling refusal without extensive retraining.

title: Nine Emotion Centroids: A Label-Free Valence Axis That Transfers Across Four Modalities
summary: This research identifies a label-free valence axis within language models that tracks emotional sentiment, discoverable from just nine emotion categories and transferable across modalities.

title: Self- and Other-Labels Induce Bidirectional Bias in LLM Judges
summary: This paper investigates how self- and other-labels induce bidirectional bias in LLM-as-a-judge systems, raising concerns about the reliability of their evaluations.

title: Abliteration Mitigation via Refusal Aliases
summary: This research proposes using refusal aliases to mitigate "abliteration," a method by which large language models' safety-aligned refusal capabilities can be removed.

title: NE-BERT: A Multilingual Language Model for Nine Northeast Indian Languages
summary: This paper introduces NE-BERT, a domain-specific multilingual encoder model trained to support nine critically underrepresented Northeast Indian languages.

title: Backdoor Learning in Language Models and Vision-Language Models
summary: This thesis addresses security vulnerabilities in deep learning models, specifically backdoor attacks in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

title: MAVEN: A Macro-Societal Value Evaluation Framework of Multimodal Content with Compact Aligned Evaluators
summary: This paper presents MAVEN, a framework for evaluating whether multimodal content aligns with macro-societal values such as peace, justice, and freedom, moving beyond existing safety taxonomies.

title: FrenchNews-7: Benchmarking Cross-Publisher French News Editorial Desk Classification
summary: This work introduces FrenchNews-7, a new benchmark for cross-publisher French news editorial desk classification, using a multi-outlet corpus and a seven-class taxonomy.

title: Fractional Decay KV-Cache: Ownership-Aware Memory Management for Improved Inference Relevancy in Dialog Systems
summary: This research proposes Fractional Decay KV-Cache (FD-KVC), a new ownership-aware memory management strategy for key-value caching in transformer-based dialog systems to improve inference relevancy.

title: Computational Orientalism: Measuring Structural Discourse Bias in Large Language Models Using the Middle East Cultural Sensitivity Score (MECSS)
summary: This study introduces the Middle East Cultural Sensitivity Score (MECSS) to measure structural discourse bias in large language models regarding cultural representations.

title: Stability-Aware Feature Design for Robust Watermark Detection in Machine-Generated Text
summary: This paper proposes a stability-aware feature design to create more robust watermark detection methods for distinguishing machine-generated text from human-written text, especially under paraphrasing.

title: DeepTCM1.0: A Multi-Expert AI Agent for Deciphering Mechanisms of Chinese Herbal Formulae Based on General Large Language Models
summary: This paper introduces DeepTCM1.0, a multi-expert AI agent designed to decipher the mechanisms of Chinese herbal formulae by integrating general large language models with traditional Chinese medicine theory.

title: StocksTalk: A Voice-Enabled Conversational Agent for Structured Query Generation over Web Data
summary: StocksTalk is a voice-enabled conversational agent that transforms spoken financial screening requests into executable and validated structured queries over real-world market data.

title: Different Facets of Verbalised Overconfidence: an Interpretability Study
summary: This interpretability study examines overconfidence in large language models, analyzing how models like Qwen3-4B express uncertainty across different logical reasoning scenarios.

title: Institutional Prestige as Geographic Bias in Large Language Models: Evidence from Three Factorial Experiments with Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
summary: This research investigates whether large language models exhibit geographic bias and systematically discriminate in candidate evaluations based on applicant ethnicity, institutional prestige, and location.

title: Same Facts, Different Updates: Inference Setup Shapes LLM Behavior in Medical Allocation
summary: This research explores how inference setup can shape large language model behavior in sensitive decision-making processes, such as medical allocation, leading to unexpected outcomes.

title: Accurate Decoding of Natural Sentences from Non-Invasive Brain Recordings
summary: This paper presents Brain2Qwerty v2, a model that enables accurate decoding of natural sentences from non-invasive brain recordings, aiming to restore communication for individuals with speech loss.

title: Temporal Multi-Signal Fusion for Token-Level Hallucination Detection
summary: This paper proposes a new method for token-level hallucination detection in generative models, treating hallucination as a temporally extended span using multi-signal fusion and sequence labeling.

title: You Are What You Prompt: Prompt Quality, Domain Shift, and Uncertainty in Agrifood Vision-Language Models
summary: This study analyzes the impact of prompt quality, domain shift, and uncertainty on the performance of agrifood vision-language models, and explores the behavior of Zero-shot Prompt Ensembling.

title: Alignment Is All You Need: Instruction-Free Training for General Audio-Language Models
summary: This paper proposes an instruction-free training approach for building general audio-language models, simplifying the typical multi-stage pipeline for multimodal large language models.

title: Language Models for Portuguese: A Systematic Mapping Study
summary: This systematic mapping study reviews the development and current landscape of language models specifically designed for the Portuguese language.

title: The Deontic Gap: Large Language Models and the Modal Language of Obligation
summary: This research examines whether large language models accurately reproduce human patterns of deontic modal usage, focusing on how they handle language of obligation like 'must' and 'should'.

title: When Do LLMs Actually Help? Evaluating LLMs as Data Quality Annotators
summary: This study evaluates the effectiveness and consistency of large language models when used as automated data quality annotators for tasks such as entity matching and brand mislabeling in e-commerce.

title: Are LLMs Safe Beyond Text: Do Emojis Expose Gaps in Safety Evaluation
summary: This work investigates whether emoji-augmented prompts expose gaps in the safety evaluations of large language models, which predominantly rely on text-based adversarial inputs.

title: Efficient INT8 Inference of Small NLP Models on Server CPUs with PyTorch Native Stack
summary: This paper discusses efficient INT8 inference for small NLP models, like BERT-family encoders, on server CPUs using the PyTorch native stack to optimize latency, throughput, and cost.

title: Figurative and Cultural Knowledge in LLMs: Investigating Cross-Domain Transfer through Fine-Tuning
summary: This paper investigates how large language models (LLMs) acquire and transfer figurative and cultural knowledge through fine-tuning, studying its impact on understanding and cultural immersion.

title: Tangut Word Segmentation under Extreme Resource Scarcity: Integrating Traditional Lexicons and Unlabeled Text
summary: This study presents a systematic approach to Tangut word segmentation, an extinct low-resource language, by integrating traditional lexicons with unlabeled text to address the lack of explicit word boundaries.

title: Pedagogical AI in Mental Health: A Tri-Stream Fine-Tuned LLM Framework for Automated Clinical Supervision and Risk Triage
summary: Researchers propose a tri-stream fine-tuned LLM framework, based on Mistral-7B-instruct, for automated clinical supervision and risk triage in mental health to address the critical shortage of senior oversight.

title: OmniAlign: A Unified Multilingual Aligner for Word and Sentence Alignment
summary: OmniAlign is introduced as a unified multilingual aligner capable of performing both word and sentence alignment, addressing the limitations of existing tools that typically specialize in a single granularity.

title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing
summary: WhiteMatter proposes a new Transformer architectural component called KV Mixing, enabling all-to-all cross-layer connections where shallow layers can attend to deeper past-token representations during autoregressive decoding.

title: MissDiag: Diagnostic Evaluation of Incomplete-Knowledge Robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG
summary: MissDiag is a diagnostic evaluation method introduced to assess the robustness of Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) and KG-RAG systems against incomplete knowledge graphs, which are common in real-world scenarios.

title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
summary: DART-SD is a new method focused on improving multi-turn tool-calling capabilities for autonomous agents by using 'diamond-topology aware retrieval and tuning' for self-distillation, moving beyond full-length trajectory imitation.

title: Shared Circuits for Shared Grammar: Tracing Subject-Verb Agreement Across Languages
summary: This research investigates whether multilingual large language models share internal mechanisms for grammatical operations, specifically tracing subject-verb agreement across different languages to understand cross-lingual generalization.

title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution
summary: This paper proposes using lightweight Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for 'Agent Failure Attribution' to diagnose complex failure modes in LLM-based multi-agent systems, identifying faulty agents and their actions.

title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs
summary: Research shows that post-training quantization (PTQ) in LLMs amplifies 'proactive interference,' a documented failure mode where retrieval of repeatedly overwritten values degrades, mirroring human working memory issues.

title: From Storage to Access: Verifiable Activation of Parametric Knowledge in LLMs via Explicit Priming and Implicit Reasoning
summary: This paper explores methods, including explicit priming and implicit reasoning, to reliably recall and verify factual knowledge encoded within large language models' parameters, aiming to address bottlenecks in factual question answering.

title: TranslatePsy-AfriSLM: High-Quality Data Scaling For Low-Resource Machine Translation
summary: TranslatePsy-AfriSLM addresses the digital divide by focusing on high-quality data scaling for low-resource machine translation in African languages, aiming to improve the performance of open-source LLMs.

title: X2Streaming-TTS: Causal Token-Level Text-to-Speech from Streaming Text with Speech-State Inheritance
summary: X2Streaming-TTS is a new token-level text-to-speech system designed for low-latency spoken dialogue by generating speech from streaming text with speech-state inheritance, ensuring perceptual continuity.

title: Learning What to Fail On: Failure-Mode Contextual Bandits for Adversarial Data Curation
summary: This work introduces a novel framework utilizing 'failure-mode contextual bandits' for adversarial data curation, aiming to improve robustness in natural language understanding by learning what types of failures to target.

title: Aslema at NADI 2026: Augmentation through Fewshot for SLU
summary: Aslema, a system for the NADI 2026 Shared Task 5, evaluates different LLMs in zero-shot and fine-tuned settings for intent recognition and slot filling, demonstrating that fine-tuning consistently outperforms zero-shot inference.

title: MemFuse: Multi-Source Memory Fusion from Fragmented Observations
summary: MemFuse is a novel memory system for agents that performs multi-source memory fusion from fragmented observations across applications and devices, addressing limitations of existing single-source memory systems.

title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science
summary: AtmosCoder-Bench is an execution-grounded benchmark introduced to evaluate large language model calculations in environmental science, making the computational process visible to reveal hidden failures beyond final answers.

title: Gradient Mirage: Trainable yet Label-Unidentifiable Gradients in Large Language Model Split Learning
summary: This research investigates gradient matching attacks (GMAs) in LLM split learning, analyzing the assumption of gradient-objective consistency and its implications for privacy when the server attempts to recover private training labels.

title: Readable, Faithful, Used: Three Dissociable Properties of Demographic Identity in a Language Model
summary: This paper examines how demographic identity is represented in language models, exploring the readability, faithfulness, and usage of inter-group differences when LLMs simulate survey respondents, addressing issues of bias and representation.

title: Decomposing Wrong-Consensus Agreement in LLM Self-Consistency: A GPT-4.1 Case Study
summary: This paper analyzes 'wrong-consensus agreement' in LLM self-consistency, explaining why majority voting sometimes fails and introducing a 'pluralistic agreement index Gamma' to quantitatively account for this phenomenon.

title: Do Large Language Models Hallucinate Electric Fata Morganas?
summary: This paper analyzes AI hallucinations, which are considered an engineering flaw, and explores their philosophical significance in relation to machine consciousness. It contributes to the broader debate on AI behavior and its implications.

title: Identifying Implicit Premises for Logical Reconstruction of Argument Graphs
summary: This research focuses on natural language processing methods to identify implicit premises (enthymemes) for the logical reconstruction of argument graphs from natural language text. It addresses challenges in accurately parsing and understanding argumentative structures.

title: Understanding Multilingual Medical ASR Adaptation Through Layer-Wise Analysis
summary: This research investigates the adaptation of multilingual medical automatic speech recognition (MedASR) models by analyzing their layer-wise behavior. It aims to improve performance in specialized terminology and limited data scenarios.

title: Assessing Quality of Experience in Natural Language Generation of German Text
summary: This paper addresses the critical need for reliable evaluation of Natural Language Generation (NLG) in German text, highlighting the shortcomings of traditional automatic metrics in capturing the quality of experience. It focuses on improving assessment methods for generated content.

title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance
summary: This paper proposes SMTrap, a novel and cost-effective method called "search amplification" for conducting Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks against large reasoning models. It aims to reduce the expense of synthesizing attack queries.

title: Human-Centric Intelligence in the Era of Foundation Models: A Survey
summary: This survey paper examines the evolution of human-centric intelligence in the era of foundation models, discussing its integration and potential for progress. It reviews recent advancements in this interdisciplinary field.

title: LumiTokens: 3D Relighting via Token-Space Lighting Transformation
summary: This paper introduces LumiTokens, a novel method for 3D relighting that utilizes token-space lighting transformation, aiming to improve efficiency over existing recomputation-heavy approaches. It leverages latent scene representations for multi-view image encoding.

title: XRF-to-Optical Field-of-View Localization with Vision Language Models
summary: This research applies Vision Language Models (VLMs) to localize the field-of-view between X-ray fluorescence (XRF) and optical microscopy images. It aims to improve the registration of complementary measurements from different imaging modalities.

title: FedCoRe: Target-Adaptive Completion for Missing Modalities in Healthcare Federated Learning
summary: This paper introduces FedCoRe (Federated Cross-Modal Representation), a target-adaptive method for completing missing modalities in healthcare federated learning. It addresses the challenge of varying data availability across different hospital sites in multimodal models.

title: A Configurable Privacy-Preserving MRI Processing Workflow Using Deep Learning-Based Brain Extraction and Adaptive Anatomical Preservation
summary: This research presents a configurable, privacy-preserving MRI processing workflow that uses deep learning for brain extraction and adaptive anatomical preservation. It aims to address privacy concerns related to facial and cranial information in structural MRI volumes.

title: Reproducible Multimodal Affordance Prediction
summary: This paper highlights the difficulties in evaluating and comparing multimodal affordance prediction methods due to heterogeneous problem formulations and inconsistent dataset annotations. It emphasizes the need for improved reproducibility in this area.

title: From Inference to Adaptation: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Vision Language Model
summary: This paper proposes a unified optimal transport framework for Vision Language Models (VLMs), aiming to improve their adaptation to real-world distribution shifts during inference. It addresses the sensitivity of VLMs to changes in data distribution.

title: TTSD-FAR: Test-Time Self-Distillation with Fisher-Anchored Restoration for Missing-Modality Emotion Recognition in LVLMs
summary: This research introduces TTSD-FAR, a method employing test-time self-distillation with Fisher-anchored restoration for missing-modality emotion recognition in large video-language models. It aims to improve performance in real-world scenarios where multimodal data may be incomplete.

title: What Does Attention Transfer Transfer? Attention Structure and Robustness in Vision Transformers
summary: This paper investigates the impact of attention transfer on the robustness and internal attention structure of Vision Transformers (ViTs). It examines how copying pretrained teacher's attention maps affects accuracy under distribution shifts.

title: COSTA: A Cluster-Centric Paradigm for Annotation-Free Open-Set Semantic Segmentation of Aerial Point Clouds with Domain Shifts
summary: This paper proposes COSTA, a cluster-centric paradigm for annotation-free open-set semantic segmentation of aerial point clouds, designed to address generalization issues and domain shifts. It focuses on adapting pre-trained models efficiently to unlabeled target-domain data.

title: Partition the Support, Reconstruct the Residual: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Video Generation and World Models
summary: This paper introduces a method for training-free sparse attention to accelerate video transformers, particularly for video generation and world models. It addresses challenges in implementing executable sparse operators despite row-wise attention concentration.

title: DyG$^2$T: Modeling Object Dynamics with 3D Gaussian Temporal-Spatial Particle Graph Transformer
summary: This paper presents DyG$^2$T, a 3D Gaussian Temporal-Spatial Particle Graph Transformer for modeling object dynamics from limited visual observations. It aims to improve accurate motion trajectory prediction in embodied interaction scenarios.

title: OptiModNet: A UNet-Transformer Hybrid with Grouped-Query and Channel Attention for Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation
summary: This paper proposes OptiModNet, a UNet-Transformer hybrid model incorporating grouped-query and channel attention, for precise optic disc and cup segmentation. It aims to achieve high performance with low computational requirements for glaucoma detection.

title: Prior-Conditioned Gaussian Discriminants for Generalizable AI-generated Image Detection
summary: This research investigates Prior-Conditioned Gaussian Discriminants for generalizable AI-generated image detection. It aims to improve the reliability of detectors against synthetic images, particularly under shifts in generator, prompt/style, and source domains.

title: StateTrace: An Object-Centric Framework for Hidden-State Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Long Videos
summary: This paper introduces StateTrace, an object-centric framework designed to improve hidden-state spatiotemporal reasoning in long videos. It addresses the challenge of inferring object states when target objects become invisible in existing video-language models.

title: Zero-Shot SAM2 Segmentation and Vision Transformer-Based Recognition of Elamite Cuneiform Symbols from Degraded Tablet Images
summary: This paper presents an AI system using Zero-Shot SAM2 segmentation and Vision Transformers to recognize ancient Elamite cuneiform symbols from degraded tablet images. It addresses challenges like varying illumination and surface erosion in historical artifact analysis.

title: PATE-Forensics: Perception-as-Tool for Explainable Deepfake Forensics with General-Purpose MLLMs
summary: PATE-Forensics introduces a 'Perception-as-Tool' paradigm for explainable deepfake forensics, decoupling detection, localization, and explanation. It leverages agent-style tool use with general-purpose MLLMs to enhance forensic analysis.

title: MR-IQA-2: Faithful Image Quality Reflection via Fine-Grained Credit Assignment
summary: This paper introduces MR-IQA-2, a method that uses fine-grained credit assignment to improve the faithfulness of multimodal large language models in image quality assessment. It addresses how MLLMs assign reasoning to their quality ratings.

title: OmniHandwritingOCR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Handwritten OCR Scenarios
summary: OmniHandwritingOCR is presented as a diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of multimodal large language models in handwritten optical character recognition (OCR) scenarios. It highlights limitations of existing benchmarks which focus on printed text.

title: FD-CanKD: Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Attention Distillation as a Refinement Prior for Compact Object Detectors
summary: FD-CanKD proposes a frequency-decoupled cross-attention distillation method as a refinement prior for compact object detectors. This technique aims to bridge the accuracy gap between small and large models in resource-constrained visual perception.

title: Teach a Molmo2Fish: Towards interactive fish tracking with natural language guidance
summary: This research explores interactive fish tracking using natural language guidance, aiming to integrate computer vision models into ecological workflows. It addresses the challenges of multi-object tracking in large ecological datasets.

title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation
summary: VA-Judger proposes a reward modeling approach that leverages human preference feedback to post-train joint video-audio generation models. This method aims to improve the quality of generated content by integrating nuanced human evaluations.

title: SPARC: Slice-to-volume Pipeline for Automated Reconstruction of gated 3D+time fetal Cardiac MRI
summary: SPARC introduces a slice-to-volume pipeline for the automated reconstruction of gated 3D+time fetal cardiac MRI. This method provides valuable diagnostic information for assessing cardiac function in complex congenital heart disease.

title: PALATE: Personalized Aesthetic Learning through Adaptive Taste Evolution for Multi-User Portrait Retouching
summary: PALATE presents a method for personalized aesthetic learning through adaptive taste evolution for multi-user portrait retouching. It aims to generate subjective yet professionally valid results by adapting to individual user preferences.

title: PCQA-R1: Advancing Generalized 3D Point Cloud Quality Assessment with Reinforcement Learning
summary: PCQA-R1 advances generalized 3D point cloud quality assessment by employing reinforcement learning within large multimodal models. This research explores no-reference PCQA, an active topic for optimizing the visual experience of point clouds.

title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models
summary: This research explores the dynamics between vision influence and safety alignment in vision-language models, observing how safety constraints can override accurate visual reasoning. It investigates the trade-offs in VLM behavior when balancing safety and factual responses.

title: SAM2Dual: Training-Free, Dual Memory for Long-Term Video Object Segmentation
summary: SAM2Dual proposes a training-free, dual memory system to address error accumulation and drift in long-term video object segmentation (VOS). It enhances SAM2's performance by improving its memory mechanism for extended sequences.

title: Clinically Structured Surrogate Rewards for Post-SFT Medical Image Captioning
summary: This paper introduces clinically structured surrogate rewards for post-supervised fine-tuning (SFT) medical image captioning, optimizing for clinical accuracy. The method uses sequence-level policy optimization to ensure concise and clinically meaningful descriptions.

title: Dynamic SpectraFormer for Ultra-High-Definition Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Dynamic SpectraFormer is presented as a specific AI model designed for ultra-high-definition underwater image enhancement. It aims to correct color distortion, haze, and poor visibility caused by light absorption in water.

title: Teeth2Point: A Two-Stage Dental CBCT ROI-to-Point Segmentation Framework
summary: Teeth2Point introduces a two-stage dental CBCT ROI-to-point segmentation framework designed for accurate tooth labeling, particularly for missing or malpositioned teeth. It leverages deep learning architectures to improve dental practice.

title: Vision-Language Models for Egocentric Video: From Hand-Object Interaction to Embodied AI
summary: This paper explores the application of Vision-Language Models to egocentric video, focusing on hand-object interaction and its implications for embodied AI. It highlights the growing importance of this perspective for wearable intelligence and human-robot interaction.

title: DynCur-Geo: Dynamic Curiosity Reward Shaping for Multimodal Active Geo-Localization
summary: DynCur-Geo proposes dynamic curiosity reward shaping for multimodal active geo-localization, enabling low-altitude UAVs to search for targets. This method addresses challenges like restricted views and sparse feedback in time-sensitive applications.

title: FRAGMENT: Factorized Graph Representations for Document Generation and Editing via Entity-Aware Transformations
summary: FRAGMENT introduces factorized graph representations and entity-aware transformations for structured document generation and editing. This method aims to better capture the interplay between spatial layout, textual content, and logical structure.

title: DocClaw: A Unified Agentic System for Intelligent Document Processing
summary: DocClaw presents a unified agentic system for intelligent document processing, encompassing tasks like OCR, document question answering, and key information extraction. This system aims to perceive and acquire knowledge from document content efficiently.

title: Composed Historical Image Retrieval by Modeling Temporal Representations
summary: This research proposes a method for composed historical image retrieval by modeling temporal representations within neural embedding spaces. It aims to improve retrieval performance by incorporating the linear progression of time.

title: Impact of Iterative Fine-Tuning on Transcription Accuracy in Complex Historical Sanskrit Manuscripts
summary: This research investigates the impact of iterative fine-tuning on improving transcription accuracy for digitizing complex historical Sanskrit manuscripts. It aims to make these texts more accessible for scholarly study.

title: A Critical Synthesis of Uncertainty Quantification and Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation
summary: This paper synthesizes uncertainty quantification methods for foundation models in semantic segmentation, addressing challenges like interpretability and overconfidence that are critical for safety-critical applications.

title: CamWorldQA: Perceptual Quality Assessment of Camera-Controlled World Video Generation
summary: This introduces CamWorldQA, a new method for perceptually assessing the quality of camera-controlled world video generation models, as existing video quality assessment methods are insufficient.

title: EgoHRV: Continuous Heart Rate Variability Estimation from Egocentric Systems for Autonomic Response and Skill Assessment
summary: This research proposes EgoHRV, a method for continuously estimating heart rate variability from egocentric vision systems to assess human autonomic responses like stress and engagement.

title: The Impact of CutMix on Reliability and Robustness in Semantic Segmentation
summary: This paper empirically studies the impact of the CutMix data augmentation strategy on the reliability and robustness of semantic segmentation models, particularly for safety-critical applications like autonomous driving.

title: A Few Cases Are All You Need: An Empirical Study of Annotation-Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning of MedSAM3
summary: This empirical study investigates the effectiveness of annotation-efficient LoRA fine-tuning of MedSAM3 for medical image segmentation, demonstrating strong performance with minimal labeled data.

title: CL4D: Contrastive Language-4D Pretraining for Vision-Language Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes
summary: This paper introduces CL4D, a contrastive language-4D pretraining framework designed to enhance vision-language reasoning capabilities for embodied AI agents operating in dynamic physical environments.

title: SED-FOD: Scattering-Aware Expert Decomposition for Few-Shot Cross-Sensor SAR Object Detection
summary: This research proposes SED-FOD, a scattering-aware expert decomposition method for improving few-shot cross-sensor object detection in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery by addressing data variations.

title: MIFR: A Modality-Invariant and Fair Representation Framework for Skin Disease Classification
summary: This paper introduces MIFR, a modality-invariant and fair representation framework designed for skin disease classification, aiming to improve diagnosis across different modalities and skin tones.

title: EfficientSync: Real-Time Lip Synchronization via Deformation-Based Reference Texture Mixing
summary: This paper introduces EfficientSync, a novel method for real-time audio-driven lip synchronization that uses deformation-based reference texture mixing for efficient and accurate mouth region manipulation.

title: EVADE: Evidence-Verified Agentic Diagnosis with Escape
summary: This paper introduces EVADE, an agentic system designed for medical diagnosis that incorporates evidence verification and an "escape" mechanism to improve reliability and calibrate trust in its responses.

title: RVLoss: Runoff Vote Loss for Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation
summary: This research introduces RVLoss (Runoff Vote Loss), a novel loss function for self-supervised LiDAR scene flow estimation that addresses limitations of traditional nearest-neighbor approaches.

title: Revisiting the "Push-T" Robot Manipulation Task with Agentic Robotics
summary: This paper revisits the "Push-T" robot manipulation task by applying concepts from Agentic Robotics, utilizing large language models to approach the problem.

title: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5: A Behavior World Model for Robust Whole-Body Control with Environment Interaction
summary: This research introduces GigaBrain-WBC-0.5, a behavior world model designed for robust whole-body control of humanoids, enabling them to interact effectively with complex environments.

title: GAPL: Grounded Action-effect Policy Learning for LLM-Based Trajectory Planning
summary: This paper proposes GAPL, a framework for Grounded Action-effect Policy Learning that enhances LLM-based trajectory planning for autonomous driving by mitigating hallucinations and improving environmental grounding.

title: GuideFetch: A Task Coordination Framework for Concurrent Navigation and Object Retrieval in Assistive Robot Dogs
summary: This paper introduces GuideFetch, a task coordination framework enabling assistive robot dogs to concurrently perform navigation and object retrieval for users.

title: The Embodiment Gap in Robot Foundation Models
summary: This paper discusses the "embodiment gap" in Robot Foundation Models and vision-language-action policies, highlighting the challenges in achieving generalization and practical deployment on physical robots.

title: HarvestPoint-ACT: Explicit Target Selection and Harvest-Point Conditioning for Robotic Fruit Harvesting under Occlusion
summary: This paper introduces HarvestPoint-ACT, a method for robotic fruit harvesting that explicitly improves target selection and harvest-point conditioning, enabling more robust grasping under occlusion.

title: Backward Layout Search for Sequence-Constrained Robotic Assembly
summary: This research focuses on robotic assembly layout planning, proposing a backward search method to determine part poses and ensure collision-free execution of assembly sequences.

title: DevGRU: Depth-guided Visual Navigation using a Collision-aware Recurrent Model
summary: This research presents DevGRU, a depth-guided visual navigation model designed to help robots avoid collisions in complex indoor environments. It aims to improve robot navigation, particularly in structured layouts and narrow passages.

title: LabDex: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Dexterous Manipulation in Laboratories
summary: LabDex is introduced as a hierarchical benchmark for evaluating robots' dexterous manipulation capabilities in laboratory settings. It aims to assess how well robots can handle diverse labware and execute complex experimental procedures.

title: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
summary: This study investigates Progressive Experience Fusion (PEF) to train a multi-task controller for autonomous endovascular navigation in robotic systems. The goal is to support the delivery of mechanical thrombectomy across varying vascular anatomies.

title: Orienteering Problem with Uncertain Time-Varying Rewards: Framework and Benchmark for Everyday Service Robotics
summary: This work introduces the orienteering problem with uncertain time-varying rewards (OP-UTVR), a novel variant for service robotics applications. It presents a framework and benchmark to address scenarios where rewards change dynamically.

title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation
summary: SoftVTBench is presented as a deformation-aware visuo-tactile dataset and benchmark for evaluating deformable-object manipulation by robots. It addresses the need for assessing interaction quality beyond mere task success, considering factors like slip and compression.

title: Dream2Reward: Transition-Alignment Reward Models from Positive Demonstrations for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Dream2Reward introduces a method for generating transition-alignment reward models from positive demonstrations to improve robotic manipulation learning. This approach aims to provide informative rewards even when robot behavior deviates from successful trajectories.

title: Beyond Placement and Articulation: Usage-Driven Code Scenes for Embodied Interaction
summary: This research explores "usage-driven code scenes" for embodied AI and robotic manipulation, moving beyond simple visual construction. It focuses on creating editable and extensible environments for simulation-based policy learning.

title: RoboEdit: Turning Human Manipulation Videos into Scalable Robot Experience
summary: RoboEdit is a human-to-robot video editing suite designed to transform human manipulation videos into physically plausible robot experiences. This tool aims to make abundant human demonstration data usable for robot training, which is typically costly to collect directly.

title: Autonomous Agricultural Tractor: Integrated Weed Detection and LiDAR Navigation for Precision Paddy Farming
summary: This research focuses on an autonomous agricultural tractor integrating weed detection and LiDAR navigation for precision paddy farming. It addresses challenges like robust navigation under canopy and real-time visual discrimination of weeds for site-specific management.

title: LT-Mem: Volatility-Aware Spatio-Temporal Memory for Lifelong Scene Understanding
summary: LT-Mem introduces a volatility-aware spatio-temporal memory system designed for lifelong scene understanding in robots. It enables persistent object-level understanding across repeated revisits to evolving environments, maintaining consistent cross-session object identity.

title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
summary: DA-WAM focuses on creating decision-aligned future latents for driving world models to enhance autonomous driving. The goal is to ensure that future predictions are not just accurate but also directly informative for decision-making in evolving road scenarios.

title: ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
summary: ADEPT is a large-scale reinforcement learning framework introduced for achieving sim-to-real transferable dexterity in high degree-of-freedom robots. It enables robots to solve long-horizon tasks using raw visuo-tactile perception.

title: PartialBiGrasp: Inferring Hidden Local Geometry for Bimanual Grasping from Partial Views
summary: PartialBiGrasp focuses on inferring hidden local geometry to enable bimanual robotic grasping from partial views. This research addresses the challenge of manipulating large, geometrically complex objects with dual-arm robots.

title: Multimodal Rapport Estimation in Real-World HRI
summary: This research investigates multimodal rapport estimation in real-world Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) to evaluate interaction quality. The goal is to use these estimations to improve robot dialogue strategies and enable autonomous behavior adaptation.

title: Engineering Psychological Safety in Autonomous Vehicles: A Systems-Theoretic Framework for Psychological Safety in Autonomous Vehicles and its Validation in Real-World Scenarios
summary: This work proposes a systems-theoretic framework for engineering psychological safety in autonomous vehicles (AVs) and validates it in real-world scenarios. It addresses psychological barriers like trust and perceived safety that limit societal acceptability of AVs.

title: Personalized Autonomous Driving via Optimal Control with Clearance Constraints from Questionnaires
summary: This research proposes a planning framework for personalized autonomous driving that incorporates user preferences for safe clearance from surrounding vehicles. It aims to enhance user comfort by explicitly considering individual desired separation distances.

title: Communications-Aware NMPC for Multi-Rotor Aerial Relay Networks Under Jamming Interference
summary: This research focuses on communications-aware Non-linear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) for multi-rotor aerial relay networks operating under jamming interference. It addresses the challenge of maintaining connectivity and optimizing motion for drones in critical missions.

title: Lexicographic Minimum-Violation Motion Planning using Signal Temporal Logic
summary: This work presents a lexicographic minimum-violation motion planning approach using Signal Temporal Logic for autonomous vehicles. It addresses scenarios where not all specifications can be met simultaneously, aiming to minimize specification violations.

title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
summary: Introduces Mask2Real-WM, a two-stage action-conditioned world model designed to bridge simulation to real-world applications for controllable dexterous robotic manipulation. It allows robots to predict action consequences and aids in policy evaluation and planning.

title: Imitation of Arm Gestures by the Semi-Humanoid Robot NICO
summary: Describes the development of a system for the semi-humanoid robot NICO to imitate human arm gestures, aiming to improve human-robot interaction.

title: Multimodal Adaptive Control for Safe Robotic Craniotomy Under Partial Observability
summary: Presents a multimodal adaptive control system for safe autonomous robotic craniotomy, designed to regulate tool-tissue interactions under partial observability to prevent damage and maintain surgical efficiency.

title: Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents
summary: Introduces a neurosymbolic embodied agent designed to factor long-horizon household tasks, aiming to address the executability issues of plans generated by language and vision-language models.

title: Breaking Planner Integrity Boundary: Enviroment State-Text Injection Attack on LLM-Driven Embodied Agents
summary: Describes an "Environment State-Text Injection Attack" that targets LLM-driven embodied agents by manipulating their planner-visible state representations, highlighting a critical security boundary.
